name: Tokyo Kowloon
source:
Near future. After a huge catastrophe befallen upon Tokyo, a large part of it has turned into slums. At such area hero is doing slave business raising girls and selling them to rich people outside the city. Usually there is a specific request, but the means of training are up to hero to decide.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
近未来，东京遭遇一场巨大灾难，大部分城区沦为贫民窟。主人公就在这样的地区从事人口贩卖：调教女孩，再把她们卖给城外的富人。买家通常会提出具体要求，至于如何调教，则完全由主人公决定。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
